domain-information: A dispatcher receives a citizen report about an ongoing incident and logs the details in the incident system.
A dispatcher assigns the nearest available patrol officer to respond to a reported incident.
A dispatcher updates the status of an incident when an officer arrives on the scene.
A patrol officer responds to an incident and assesses the situation for immediate action.
A patrol officer files a field report of the incident summarizing what happened at the scene.
A patrol officer transfers a serious incident case to an investigator for further examination.
An investigator takes over the investigation of a serious incident.
An investigator reviews a field report and creates a case file for ongoing investigation.
An investigator requests evidence collection from the evidence technician.
An evidence technician collects physical evidence from a scene and logs it into the evidence database.
An evidence technician assigns the evidence record to the investigation.
A records clerk receives completed case files from investigators and archives them in the department’s record system.

domain objects.name: Dispatcher
domain objects.description: Coordinates incident responses and assigns officers.

domain objects.name: Citizen Report
domain objects.description: Initial report submitted by a citizen about an incident.

domain objects.name: Citizen
domain objects.description: Individual reporting an incident to the police department.

domain objects.name: Incident System
domain objects.description: Digital system where incidents are logged and tracked.

domain objects.name: Status
domain objects.description: Current state of an incident, such as 'reported', 'in progress', or 'resolved'.

domain objects.name: Field Report
domain objects.description: Summary written by a patrol officer after responding to an incident.

domain objects.name: Investigation
domain objects.description: Ongoing process of examining an incident and collecting evidence.

domain objects.name: Case File
domain objects.description: Complete record of an investigation, containing all related information.

domain objects.name: Evidence
domain objects.description: Physical or digital material collected for an investigation.

domain objects.name: Patrol Officer
domain objects.description: Responds to reported incidents and files field reports.

domain objects.name: Case Transfer
domain objects.description: Formal process of assigning a case from a patrol officer to an investigator.

domain objects.name: Investigator
domain objects.description: Handles complex cases and leads investigations.

domain objects.name: Evidence Request
domain objects.description: Request sent by an investigator for evidence collection or analysis.

domain objects.name: Evidence Technician
domain objects.description: Collects, logs, and manages physical evidence.

domain objects.name: Evidence Database
domain objects.description: System for recording and storing details of collected evidence.

domain objects.name: Records Clerk
domain objects.description: Archives completed case files in the department’s record system.

domain objects.name: Record System
domain objects.description: Central archive for managing and retrieving case files.

associations.description: Dispatcher logs incident in incident system.
Dispatcher assigns patrol officer to incident.
Evidence request sent to evidence technician.
Evidence technician logs evidence in database.
Evidence technician assigns evidence to investigation.
Investigator submits case file to records clerk.
Records clerk archives case file in record system.
